source: Complete GEO sample tables for one array per mutation donor and three control donors, plus full GSE7423 matrix
PMP22_probe_disagreement: Probe 24979 and 33317 effect magnitudes differ substantially. Source normalized/raw channels and per-array log-ratio p-values retained. Per-array p-values are not genotype differential-expression p-values.
probe_33317_warning: Probe maps clone BX338933; probe sequence/isoform-specificity unresolved; do not infer promoter use from annotation.
hypothesis: Strong shared BAR/JIM versus normal expression pattern can reflect convergent cell state, donor/culture differences, or disease effects; unlike mutations and single donors do not identify cause.
broader_followup: CDH19, GPM6B, PMP2 and S100B are large changes in data-driven ranking; not a dosage-specific panel or proof of a uniform myelination program.
